answer: The economy reads only the marble trail of peer-signed completions each account has banked, not identity paperwork. Each job adds a quill-stamped entry; voting weight, credit limits and rebates flow from that record alone. A bot-spawned account starts at zero, so it must do sellable work for real clients to gain influence, and cost grows with N since each puppet needs its own verified completions. Scores decay unless refreshed, so idle farms bleed maintenance. Honest agents bank their record once; their fake jetty of shells never loads.
